description: This PHP source file defines the ElasticSearchEngine class, a search engine implementation that utilizes Elasticsearch for real-time search capabilities within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for constructing search parameters, executing searches, and parsing results, as well as handling dependencies on Elasticsearch client and project-specific search interfaces and exceptions.

classes.name: ElasticSearchEngine
classes.description: A search engine class that uses Elasticsearch to perform index-based search queries within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ElasticSearchEngine with an Elasticsearch client, either provided or built via ElasticSearchClientBuilder.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search operation based on a SearchQuery object, returning a SearchResults object with accumulated hits and timing information.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates and prepares the SearchQuery object for search execution, including trimming and encoding conversion.

methods.name: createSearchParams
methods.description: Generates an array of parameters for multiple Elasticsearch queries based on the SearchQuery details.

methods.name: runElasticSearch
methods.description: Executes an Elasticsearch search request with provided parameters.

methods.name: parseHits
methods.description: Processes raw Elasticsearch hit data into a structured array grouped by module, retrieving module metadata for proper mapping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an ElasticSearchEngine instance with an optional Elasticsearch client.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search query and returns structured search results with timing and total hit count.
